crap.collections.posts = _coll_posts

--- Define a lifecycle hook for the `posts` collection (`before_validate`,
--- `before_change`, `after_change`, `before_read` — listed in the collection's
--- `hooks` table). The wrapper is a runtime no-op; its purpose is to narrow
--- `ctx` to `crap.hook.Posts` so `ctx.data.<field>` autocompletes.
---@param fn crap.hook_fn.Posts
---@return crap.hook_fn.Posts
function _coll_posts.hook(fn) end

--- Define an `after_read` hook for the `posts` collection. Runtime no-op;
--- LuaLS narrows `ctx` to `crap.read_hook.Posts`, whose `ctx.data` is
--- the document as the read returns it (`crap.doc.Posts`).
---@param fn crap.read_hook_fn.Posts
---@return crap.read_hook_fn.Posts
function _coll_posts.read_hook(fn) end

---@overload fun(field: "title", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "summary", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "published_at", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "snippet", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "body", fn: fun(value: string|table, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string|table?)
---@overload fun(field: "teaser", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "scores", fn: fun(value: number[], ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): number[]?)
---@overload fun(field: "keywords", fn: fun(value: string[], ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string[]?)
---@overload fun(field: "active", fn: fun(value: boolean, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): boolean?)
---@overload fun(field: "data", fn: fun(value: any, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): any?)
---@overload fun(field: "internal_note", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "status", fn: fun(value: "draft" | "published", ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): "draft" | "published"?)
---@overload fun(field: "layout", fn: fun(value: "grid" | "list", ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): "grid" | "list"?)
---@overload fun(field: "categories", fn: fun(value: ("news" | "guides"|string)[], ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): ("news" | "guides"|string)[]?)
---@overload fun(field: "author", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "tags", fn: fun(value: string[], ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string[]?)
---@overload fun(field: "cover", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: "related", fn: fun(value: string[], ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string[]?)
---@overload fun(field: "featured", fn: fun(value: string, ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts): string?)
---@overload fun(field: string, fn: crap.field_hook_fn.Posts)
---@overload fun(fn: crap.field_hook_fn.Posts)
--- Define a field hook for the `posts` collection. Two-arg form
--- (`field_hook("<field>", fn)`) narrows `value` to the typed field;
--- single-arg form (`field_hook(fn)`) leaves `value` as `any`.
--- Use for value transformation (e.g. slug normalization, computed
--- defaults). Runtime no-op; LuaLS uses the signature to infer `value`
--- and `ctx: crap.field_hook.Posts`.
function _coll_posts.field_hook(field, fn) end

--- Display condition for an admin-UI field on the `posts` collection.
--- Return `true`/`false` for visible/hidden, or a table
--- `{ visible = bool, error = string? }` for richer control. Runtime
--- no-op; LuaLS narrows `data` to `crap.data.Posts`.
---@param fn crap.display_condition_fn.Posts
---@return crap.display_condition_fn.Posts
function _coll_posts.condition(fn) end

--- Access-control function for `posts` operations. Return `true`/`false`
--- for global allow/deny, or a filter table to constrain results.
--- Runtime no-op; context type (`crap.AccessContext`) is uniform across
--- collections, so this is just a discoverable alias for `crap.any.access`.
---@param fn crap.access_fn
---@return crap.access_fn
function _coll_posts.access(fn) end

--- Custom auth-strategy `authenticate` callback for the `posts` collection.
--- Receives request headers + the slug; returns a user document on
--- success or `nil` to fall through. Runtime no-op; discoverable alias
--- for `crap.any.auth_strategy`.
---@param fn crap.auth_strategy_fn
---@return crap.auth_strategy_fn
function _coll_posts.auth_strategy(fn) end

--- Compute a display label for an array/blocks row on the `posts`
--- collection. Receives the row table and returns a string (or `nil`
--- to fall back to `label_field`). Runtime no-op; discoverable alias
--- for `crap.any.row_label`.
---@param fn crap.row_label_fn
---@return crap.row_label_fn
function _coll_posts.row_label(fn) end

--- for global allow/deny, or a filter table to constrain results.

--- collections, so this is just a discoverable alias for `crap.any.access`.
---@param fn crap.access_fn
---@return crap.access_fn
function _coll_users.access(fn) end

--- Custom auth-strategy `authenticate` callback for the `users` collection.
--- Receives request headers + the slug; returns a user document on
--- success or `nil` to fall through. Runtime no-op; discoverable alias
--- for `crap.any.auth_strategy`.
---@param fn crap.auth_strategy_fn
---@return crap.auth_strategy_fn
function _coll_users.auth_strategy(fn) end

--- Compute a display label for an array/blocks row on the `users`
--- collection. Receives the row table and returns a string (or `nil`
--- to fall back to `label_field`). Runtime no-op; discoverable alias
--- for `crap.any.row_label`.
---@param fn crap.row_label_fn
---@return crap.row_label_fn
function _coll_users.row_label(fn) end

--- Define a lifecycle hook for the `settings` global (`before_validate`,
--- `before_change`, `after_change`, `before_read`). Runtime no-op; LuaLS narrows
--- `ctx` to `crap.hook.global_settings` so `ctx.data.<field>` autocompletes.
---@param fn crap.hook_fn.global_settings
---@return crap.hook_fn.global_settings
function _glob_settings.hook(fn) end

--- Define an `after_read` hook for the `settings` global. Runtime no-op;
--- LuaLS narrows `ctx` to `crap.read_hook.global_settings`, whose `ctx.data`
--- is the document as the read returns it (`crap.global_doc.Settings`).
---@param fn crap.read_hook_fn.global_settings
---@return crap.read_hook_fn.global_settings
function _glob_settings.read_hook(fn) end

---@overload fun(field: string, fn: crap.field_hook_fn.global_settings)
---@overload fun(fn: crap.field_hook_fn.global_settings)
--- Define a field hook for the `settings` global. Two-arg form narrows
--- `value` to the typed field; single-arg form leaves it as `any`.
--- Runtime no-op; LuaLS uses the signature to infer `value` and
--- `ctx: crap.field_hook.global_settings`.
function _glob_settings.field_hook(field, fn) end

---@return crap.display_condition_fn.global_settings
function _glob_settings.condition(fn) end
